## About this dataset

Everglades National Park has an extensive fire program. The park records both prescribed and wildfires by digitizing fires that occur within the park boundaries. Fire perimeters are provided as a shape file that has all known fires that occurred from 1948 to 2019. These perimeters were digitized by park staff to record the outer boundaries of fires. Annual shape files of fires obtained from the park were standardized in R and combined into a single shape file. Although much of the Everglades is inundated throughout different parts of the year, these are fire maintained ecosystems.

## Variables

`YEAR` · `FIRE_NAME` · `DISC_DATE` · `GEN_CAUSE` · `FIRE_TYPE` · `SPEC_CAUSE` · `DECLD_DATE`

_Units, definitions and uncertainty are documented in the archived metadata (EML)._

## Research applications

- Long-term fire history of Everglades National Park

## Known limitations [needs review]{.badge .text-bg-warning}

- Superseded for 1978-2023 by "Fire in the Everglades"; kept for the pre-1978 record

::: {.panel-tabset}
### R

```r
# install.packages("dataone")
library(dataone)

d1c <- D1Client("PROD", "urn:node:KNB")
pkg <- getDataPackage(d1c, identifier = "urn:uuid:85d38839-ce8c-4a00-a0df-e6080cbe8de3", lazyLoad = TRUE, quiet = FALSE)
getIdentifiers(pkg)   # files in the package
```
